title: Women's political participation
quote: Local bodies: one-third floor (half in 19 States/UTs) vs legislatures: one-third only after delimitation

items.what: In force for **J&K and Puducherry** Assemblies

boxes.title: 106th Amendment: Art. 334A
items: **One-third** incl. one-third of SC/ST seats; ==**no OBC sub-quota**==
Starts after ==first Census after the Act + delimitation== (**2027 Census** → not before **2034**)
Duration **15 years**; Parliament may extend
Seats **rotate** after each delimitation
131st Bill aimed Lok Sabha **550 → 850** on **2011 Census**

boxes.title: 73rd/74th: women in local bodies
items: **243D(2)**: one-third of SC/ST seats to SC/ST women (⚠ not 50%)
One-third = ==**floor, not ceiling**==; **Bihar** first **50%** (**2006**)
**19 States/UTs** at **50%**; AP **50%** in panchayats & municipalities
Min age **21** (**243F, 243V**); 73rd in force **24 April 1993**
Women **~46%** of PRI representatives; no sunset (SC/ST till **2030**)

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: APPSC 2019: AP PRIs = **1/2** of seats; APPSC 2007: local-body reservation first
APPSC-GS 2024: 106th assent **2023**; ⚠ **128th** Bill = **106th** Act
⚠ 106th excludes **Rajya Sabha** & Councils; ST seats in municipalities = **243T(1)** (MPPSC 2020)
Women's turnout exceeded men's first in **2019**
